personality_one_liner: A friendly, energetic, and highly approachable community app designed to connect amateur Padel players.

spacing.rule: Generous, breathable rhythm. Use chunky paddings (lg, xl) for cards and sections. Make tap targets oversized (min 48pt).

dont's: No glassmorphism for Tactile/Playful. Use solid chunky colors, soft shadows, and clean borders.

screens.name: Home / Clubs Directory
screens.purpose: Discover padel clubs by region and view active players looking for matches.

states.loading: Chunky skeleton cards with soft pulsing animation.
states.empty: Playful illustration of an empty court with a 'Suggest a Club' button.
states.error: Friendly error message with a bright orange 'Try Again' button.

screens.layout: Sticky top search bar and region filters (pill shape). A vertical list of chunky club cards. Each card has a real photo cover (with gradient-to-dark scrim if text is overlaid), club name, location, and a badge indicating active 'Looking for players' requests. Generous padding around the cards to make them feel touchable.

screens.name: Club Detail & Group Chat
screens.purpose: Hub for a specific club showing its details and the community announcements.

states.empty: Illustration of a padel racket resting; 'Be the first to post an announcement!'

screens.layout: Hero image at the top with club name and 'Join Chat' CTA. Below is a segmented control (Info / Announcements). The Announcements tab acts as a group chat feed: stacked message bubbles/cards from users stating their availability. Sticky 'Post Announcement' CTA anchored at the bottom above safe area.

screens.name: Player Profile
screens.purpose: Showcase a player's level, reliability rating, and provide an action to message them.
screens.layout: Centered large avatar. Name and pseudo in display font. A large interactive 'Reliability Stars' component (e.g. 4.5/5 stars with big star icons). A pill badge showing their playing level (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced). A wide, pill-shaped primary 'Message Player' CTA pinned at the bottom. Below the avatar, a section showing 'Recent Activity' or preferred clubs.

screens.name: Messages Inbox
screens.purpose: List of active 1-to-1 conversations with other players.

states.empty: Illustration of a quiet inbox with a prompt to 'Find a club to connect with players'.
states.error: Failed to load chats, pull to refresh.

screens.layout: Standard list view with generous row height (72pt+). Each row has the player's avatar, name, last message snippet, and timestamp. Unread messages have a bold font and a small brandPrimary dot.

screens.name: Private Chat
screens.purpose: 1-to-1 direct messaging to arrange a padel match.

states.error: Failed to send message red exclamation mark.

screens.layout: Classic chat layout. Incoming messages are surfaceSecondary bubbles; outgoing are brandPrimary bubbles with onBrandPrimary text. Input composer pinned at the bottom with a rounded text field and a circular send button. The header shows the player's avatar and name, tapping it goes to their profile.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Tactile/Playful theme strictly: use chunky borders, pill-shaped buttons, and rounded (lg/pill) cards.
Do NOT use any blue colors in the UI (strict ban). The brand color is vibrant orange (#FF6B15) to evoke clay courts and energy.

For the clubs directory, use the 'hero_court' images provided as background covers for the cards. Make sure to apply a gradient-to-dark scrim (top-to-bottom, transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse) over the image before placing white text on top.
The primary CTA (e.g., 'Message Player' or 'Post Announcement') should always be sticky at the bottom of the screen, floating above the scrollable content with proper safe-area bottom padding.
Ensure touch targets are large and accessible (minimum 48x48pt).
Use Phosphor icons consistently (filled for active tabs, outlined for inactive).
Implement the 5-star rating system visually using star icons inside the Player Profile.
